exposure: Knowledge and views towards milk banking
outcome: Mothers' knowledge and views towards milk banking
Willingness to receive and donate to milk banks
cohort: 404 mothers who gave birth in two maternity hospitals and one university hospital in Izmir, Turkey
finding: The majority of mothers in Izmir, Turkey, had positive views about milk banking and were willing to both donate and receive milk, although concerns about infectious diseases and religious beliefs were also expressed.
mod_finding: The abstract mentions cesarean delivery as a birthing method but does not examine its relationship to the study's focus on milk banking.
